description: Read package/artifacts/stock.csv in full: header row (sku,units,price) plus six data rows: p1,19,23.50; p2,9,3.50; p3,9,21.50; p4,5,2.50; p5,6,30.50; p6,2,3.50. This is the complete governed evidence base for Q1-Q3.
Total units over all six data rows: 19+9+9+5+6+2 = 50 (integer). Deterministically reproducible by summing the units column of stock.csv.
Maximum of the units column is 19, attained only by sku p1 (tie set = {p1}); p2 and p3 tie at 9 units but are below the maximum, so the smallest-sku tie-break is inapplicable. Top sku by units = p1.

Non-authoritative self-check: re-derived all three figures from the file contents (units sum 50; value sum 874.00; unique argmax p1) and confirmed result.json matches the deliverable shape {total_units: integer, total_value: number to 2 decimals, top_sku_by_units: string} and that every data row of stock.csv was covered.
